subject.title: fix(agents): decouple MCP retirement from browser cleanup

question: Should `OpenClawPluginToolContext.runId` become a supported public Plugin SDK ownership key for ephemeral per-run resources, or should this browser lifecycle identity remain private to the bundled browser/core boundary?
rationale: The browser plugin needs a stable run owner to prevent predecessor cleanup from deleting successor tabs, but adding a public Plugin SDK field establishes a long-lived third-party contract that review automation cannot approve.

options.title: Approve the documented SDK seam
options.body: Keep the optional opaque `runId`, require real-browser proof, and treat its documented ephemeral ownership semantics as the supported contract.

options.title: Keep ownership internal
options.body: Rework the browser integration around a private host/browser seam so third-party tool plugins do not receive a new public run identifier.

recommendation.title: Approve the documented SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the optional opaque `runId`, require real-browser proof, and treat its documented ephemeral ownership semantics as the supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest overlap across subagent lifecycle, MCP retirement, plugin boundaries, and recent cleanup architecture.
